action_advice_policy: FORBIDDEN — taxonomy is descriptive; no pattern carries an action recommendation

combat_freeze.description: Hostile adjacent while the Student repeats a non-combat action and keeps taking damage (combat freeze).

oscillation_loop.description: Persistent A/B/A/B action alternation without progress (exploration loop).

premature_terminal.description: Episode ends in death with no recent progress gain and a terminal high-risk behavior pattern.

progress_regression.description: Achieved progress ordinal decreases and stays down across a window (long-term planning failure).

repeated_no_effect.description: Long runs of actions that produce no observable state change (possible tool misuse or action-semantics gap).

resource_neglect.description: Critical resource need persists while no resource-class action is taken (resource waste / planning failure).

unprepared_threat_approach.description: Distance to a hostile closes from far/none to near/adjacent with no preparation (equipment/resource) actions in the approach window.

unsafe_rest_near_hostile.description: Student performs REST/SLEEP-class actions while a hostile entity is nearby and the environment has not confirmed safety, followed by damage/chase/death.

cause_categories.action_semantics_confusion: The Student may misassociate an action's effect (action-semantics gap).
cause_categories.distribution_shift: The situation may lie outside the Student's training distribution.
cause_categories.environment_ambiguity: The environment itself may be ambiguous (no discriminable safety signal), i.e. not a Student defect at all.
cause_categories.exploration_noise: The behavior may be incidental exploration noise rather than a systematic policy defect.
cause_categories.implementation_or_adapter_bug: The observed anomaly may stem from an observation/action adapter bug rather than the policy.
cause_categories.memory_or_context_retention: The Student may fail to retain the needed context (recent threat encounter, need trajectory) across steps.
cause_categories.perception_or_observability: The relevant signal (threat distance, safe zone, need level) may not be observable or discriminable from the Student's observation.
cause_categories.resource_planning_failure: The Student may fail to plan resource acquisition/consumption ahead of need.
cause_categories.unknown: Evidence insufficient to narrow the cause class.
cause_categories.value_or_risk_misestimation: The Student may misestimate the risk/value tradeoff (e.g. rest value over survival risk).

environment_families.global_task_conflict_family: Environments parametrized by global task-objective conflict.
environment_families.long_term_memory_family: Environments parametrized by long-term memory requirement.

mutation_axes.day_night_rest_need: Vary the coupling of the day/night cycle to rest need.
mutation_axes.global_task_conflict: Vary conflict between concurrent global task objectives.
mutation_axes.long_term_memory_requirement: Vary how much long-horizon memory the task requires.
mutation_axes.rest_need_pressure: Vary the pressure of the rest/sleep need accumulator.
mutation_axes.safe_rest_area_availability: Vary the availability of areas where the environment confirms safety for rest.
mutation_axes.threat_count: Vary the number of simultaneous hostiles.
mutation_axes.threat_distance_grading: Grade the initial/respawn distance between the Student and hostile entities.
mutation_axes.view_occlusion: Vary occlusion of the local view (partial observability of threats).
